title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
summary: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a 2026 racing game from the developers behind Hot Wheels Unleashed & Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged. Developed and published by Milestone S.r.l., the game has been released on 10 September 2026, for the Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Microsoft Windows.

title: 2026 Singapore Hot Wheels Convention
summary: The 2026 Singapore Hot Wheels Convention (officially the 1st Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention Singapore 2026) took place from 25 to 27 September 2026 in Singapore. Andrés Andrieu was the guest of honor at the event. As with all previous editions, this event was organized by Korei.
